liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): Listener claims this performance made them question physics and religion, specifically regarding Phil Lesh; Reviewer finds this version too loosely held together for their personal taste [6][8][15]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best China Rider of all time, noting it is from Europe '72 [11]
- **Sing Me Back Home** (1 review): Reviewer says the band gave the French audience a taste of pure Nashville with this song [12]
- **Me and Bobby McGee** (1 review): Listener notes a touch of softness emerging in this particular performance of the song [8]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer calls this one of the best versions heard, noting Weir is in his best voice [9]
- Reviewer identifies this as the best version, highlighting the slide guitar work similar to Rooster [16]

## The recordings

- **gd72-05-03.sbd.masse.142.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 215 min; rated 4.81/5 by 36 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer states this recording is pure clean, unlike the other version which has channel problems [16]
- **gd72-05-03.sbd.samaritano.21923.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 33 songs; 215 min; rated 4.07/5 by 14 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the third disc as deeply moving, though not the hottest or jazziest; Reviewer notes the band is really in synch tonight, delivering almost flawless versions of key songs [7][12]
- **gd1972-05-03.sbd.samaritano.29082.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 193 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the source channels flew all over the place, requiring de-clicking and normalization [5]
- **gd1972-05-03.sbd.masse.6453.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 33 songs; 215 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Pigpen's voice sounds weak during the Not Fade Away exchange, creating an epic yet sad moment [11]
- Reviewer states both May 3 and May 4 shows epitomize the band at their peak [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-05-03.sbd.masse.142.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by J Norman and D Latvala; source: SBD > multitrack 2" MR > rough mix [1]. Also: Source is a soundboard transferred to multitrack 2-inch master, then rough mixed by J [1]
- **gd72-05-03.sbd.samaritano.21923.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: Soundboard>Master Reel (multi-track)->DAT x 5 [4]
- **gd1972-05-03.sbd.samaritano.29082.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: SBD > Master Reel (multi-track) [5]
- **gd1972-05-03.sbd.masse.6453.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Mike Masse; source: SBD > reel > DAT > CDR > EAC > shn [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1972-05-03 Olympia Theater, Paris, France](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/07/grateful-dead-1972-05-03-olympia.html) [19]
- Poster by The Record Centre: [Grateful Dead – Olympia Theatre, Paris, France 5/3/72 (6LP box set NEW SEALED US 2021 Record Store Day release 180 gm vi](https://therecordcentre.com/grateful-dead-olympia-theatre-paris-france-5-3-72-6lp-box-set-new-sealed-us-2021-record-store-day-release-180-gm-vinyl/) [20]
- Poster by www.popsike.com: [popsike.com - Login - vinyl records price guide](https://www.popsike.com/GRATEFUL-DEAD-LIVE-OLYMPIA-THEATRE-PARIS-FRANCE-5372-6-LPs-BOX-SET-RSD-2021/313565838239.html) [21]
- Poster by Discords.nl: [The Grateful Dead - Olympia Theatre, Paris, France (5/3/72) (LP Tweedehands)](https://discords.nl/products/the-grateful-dead-olympia-theatre-paris-france-5-3-72) [22]
